newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL- Columbia/HCA shares higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL- Columbia/HCA shares higher.

text.p: Shares in Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp moved higher in after-hours trading Monday to 34-1/4, traders said.
"A lot of people are looking at it," one dealer said.
The company did not release any news Monday, a company spokewoman said. Other calls to the company seeking further comment were not immediately returned.
Some technology shares also rose in the after-market, following a day of losses on Nasdaq.
Ascend Communications Inc inched up to 45-1/16 after losing more than four points earlier Monday to close at 44-11/16. Intel edged up to 96-1/2, after losing 1-11/16 to close at 96-1/8.
Dell traded at 76, after closing off more than three points at 75-3/4.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 3,700, compared to 347,200 Friday, and session two had volume of 783,450, compared to 1.7 million Friday.
